verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an API Playground, a browser-based GraphQL explorer. It lets users explore the API schema and run queries and mutations against the live API in real time, backed by GraphQL introspection, which covers the core of an interactive, runnable API reference. Access requires administrator privileges and a valid API key, requests run against the live tenant rather than a sandbox, and the explorer returned 403 to the automated probe, so runnability rests on vendor docs alone. missing for 10: pre-built runnable example snippets in the reference, sandbox/non-production execution, downloadable OpenAPI/Postman spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Sprinto API Playground is a browser-based GraphQL explorer that lets you interact with the Sprinto Developer API without installing any client libraries or GraphQL tools
You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
Introspection allows the API to describe its schema, including available queries, mutations, and response types.
